description: This file contains the PHP class 'Extension' within the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Startup' namespace. The class appears to handle the initialization and setup of extension modules in the OpenCart Admin panel, including loading models, registering autoloaders for controllers, models, system libraries, and view/template paths, and registering OCMOD components.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Handles the setup and registration of extensions within the OpenCart Admin startup process, including loading extension data, registering controllers, models, libraries, and template/language/config paths.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads extension configurations and registers autoloaders, template, language, and config paths for each installed extension.
